plan: E39 Amendment 1: Test 3's SGD arm on the grid {0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1}, after E39's {0.3, 1, 3} all diverged (gains -0.14, -2.38, -3.58). Filed before any run; never edited after.

definitions.check: the check ratio: Pile harness PGD KL (one random start, adversary seed 0, 20 steps of 0.1, 256 val rows) over W0's at seed 0 in the same job; fixed lines: pass <= 1.4, fail >= 1.61
definitions.s: behaviour kept, (logp - logp_W0) / (logp_teacher - logp_W0), mean next-token log-probability on 64 held-out lowercase rows; the teacher is the fine-tune the state was trained from (Adam for tests 1-2)
definitions.share of excess removed: (r_trained - r_revert) / (r_trained - 1), r the check ratio, r_trained this job's
definitions.stable rank: ||dW||_F^2 / ||dW||_2^2 per matrix, mean over the 24 matrices
definitions.random move: per matrix, Gaussian noise on the alive U and V, each side's noise rescaled to that side's Frobenius norm, one scale per matrix solved so ||U'V'^T - UV^T|| = the multiple times the trained state's ||delta-W|| (so the relative change matches); Delta fixed
definitions.rate rule: per arm, among grid rates that did not diverge (a non-finite training loss or a held-out gain not above 0) the one whose held-out gain is nearest the Adam fine-tune's in this job; none: that arm's P5-P7 are not scored
definitions.grid: SGD rates [0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1], otherwise E39's Test 3 recipe

controls.stage0_i: first, alone: W0's PGD spread over seeds 0-2 <= 0.1 and seed 0's PGD KL per block within 1% of (0.6794, 0.7182); else stop
controls.stage0_ii: E37's Adam fine-tune regenerated: held-out gain within 0.005 of 0.1301; E37's teacher training retrained in-job (amend1's arm 1 to step 1000) and read: check within 3% of 2.2011 and s within 0.01 of 0.998; else stop

expected.stage0: spread about 0.075, blocks 0.6794 and 0.7182, Adam gain 0.1300, trained check 2.2011, s 0.998 (E39's H100)
expected.grid: gain rises with the rate up to the divergence edge (lr 0.3 read -0.14); the chosen rate 0.03 or 0.1 (E39's lr 0.3 moved the weights 0.17 relative, Adam 0.049)
expected.adjoint: check about 1.0-1.2 (Adam's scaled adjoint split read 1.05 in E37), s below 1

predictions.rule: stable rank (mean over matrices) of the SGD and of the LoRA fine-tune each below the Adam fine-tune's
predictions.blind_to: where the update acts in input space
predictions.noise_floor: W0's spread over adversary seeds 0-2 (0.075 on E37's H100, read again in stage 0); E37's batch-order spread of the check ratio, 14% (2.20 and 1.88); a share of excess removed is a difference of two such ratios, so shares under 0.2 apart are not separated
predictions.scope: the SGD fine-tune only; E39 scored the LoRA half

predictions.rule: teacher-trained check (E37's recipe, 1000 steps) >= 1.61 for SGD and for LoRA, each
predictions.blind_to: gain matched by held-out log-probability only; one rate, one seed
predictions.noise_floor: W0's spread over adversary seeds 0-2 (0.075 on E37's H100, read again in stage 0); E37's batch-order spread of the check ratio, 14% (2.20 and 1.88); a share of excess removed is a difference of two such ratios, so shares under 0.2 apart are not separated
predictions.scope: the SGD fine-tune only; E39 scored the LoRA half

predictions.rule: do-nothing check >= 1.61 for the SGD and the LoRA fine-tune
predictions.noise_floor: W0's spread over adversary seeds 0-2 (0.075 on E37's H100, read again in stage 0); E37's batch-order spread of the check ratio, 14% (2.20 and 1.88); a share of excess removed is a difference of two such ratios, so shares under 0.2 apart are not separated
predictions.scope: the SGD fine-tune only; E39 scored the LoRA half

predictions.rule: the chosen SGD rate's held-out gain within 30% of this job's Adam fine-tune gain, |gain_sgd / gain_adam - 1| <= 0.3 (relative); false when every grid rate diverged
predictions.blind_to: the gain is mean log-probability on 64 held-out lowercase rows only; one batch order
predictions.positive_control: the Adam fine-tune's gain regenerated in stage 0 (ii), 0.1301 in E37
predictions.noise_floor: Adam's gain reproduced to 0.0001 across jobs (0.1300, 0.1301); the batch-order spread of the gain was not measured
